turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
on tracking is frustrating. Normally, tracking is sent by email once the order ships. Delivery after dispatch is usually 2 to 5 working days within New Zealand, allowing up to 8 working days, and 2 to 8 working days for Australia and other international orders. During sale periods, dispatch can take an extra 3 to 9 business days, and Blackout orders can take around 12 to 15 business days to dispatch. If you want me to check your specific order, please log in first.
